messages:
vantage_pm: Hi team — Vantage wants to onboard a compact 4B domain summarizer for invoices + delivery notes. Constraint: redact VAT numbers and payments info. Need EU hosting, private VPC, HSM for signing. Go-live target: 3 weeks.

lina_cs: Thanks. Please share model artifact and dataset sizes. Also confirm whether deterministic outputs required. cc @oscar for eval and infra bits.

vantage_pm: Artifact: https://s3.vantage.ai/v4b-invoice-2026.tar.gz. Data: 90k invoices, 25k notes. Deterministic summaries preferred for audit trails.

oscar: Eval plan: will run fidelity (ROUGE), PII residual scan for VAT/IBAN, and stability tests. Need 300 labeled eval examples + 100 adversarial probes. Also propose canary: 10%->50%->100% with rollback on PII >0 or p95 > 250ms.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-8133 created: "Vantage 4B private EU onboarding" Assignees: lina_cs, oscar, infra.estimated_window: 2026-04-20..2026-04-27

lina_cs: Ops note: EU Private + HSM supported; extra region charge applies. We can disable long-term logging and enable ephemeral logs + redaction hook. Will schedule enablement call.

vantage_pm: Legal wants a redaction demo and signed response proof before sign-off.

oscar: We'll include a demo in the enablement call: redaction hook -> signed payload (HSM) -> PII-residual report. ETA: 48h after we receive sanitized eval set.

vantage_pm: Uploading sanitized eval set to https://files.vantage.ai/safe-eval tonight. Also attaching retention policy.

lina_cs: I'll add renewal risk: flagged as medium if post-canary p95 exceeds target or any PII incidents. Scheduling enablement Thu 10am CET. Invite sent.

eval-bot: Eval job queued: EJ-4421 (vantage/4b) — status: queued.

oscar: Quick infra ask: please confirm tokenization (BPE) and input max tokens. Also upload tokenizer files.

vantage_pm: Tokenizer included in artifact. Max length 1024.

oscar: Good. I'll start the harness once samples arrive. Lina, please coordinate procurement estimate for EU Dedicated + HSM.

lina_cs: Will send estimate by EOD. Closing loop: enablement call + demo + canary plan.

vantage_pm: Thanks everyone — will upload tonight and stand by for the call.
